newsitem.title: USA: Cinergi Pictures considers possible sale.
newsitem.headline: Cinergi Pictures considers possible sale.

text.p: Cinergi Pictures Entertainment Inc Tuesday said it was still reviewing its business strategies and goals, an exercise that could lead to the sale of a partial interest in the company or the entire business.
In a statement, the independent motion picture producer and distributor said no agreements or understandings had been reached with any third parties regarding any such sale.

Earlier, Cinergi posted a third-quarter loss of $294,000, or $0.02 per share, compared with a net loss of $9,059,000, or $0.64 per share, during the same period last year. Revenues fell to $30.2 million from $51.5 million.

Though Cinergi released new motion pictures in theaters during the third quarter, the company said its revenues came from the U.S. availability of "Nixon" on home video, domestic and international availability of "Amanda," and continued domestic and foreign income from "Die Hard With a Vengeance" and "Tombstone".
